resources.string: Detects vertical short-form video swipes strictly inside Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts to update your live BrainPal Dynamic Island counter and Digital Wellbeing analytics. Home feeds and personal messages are never tracked.
Dynamic Island activates automatically when Instagram Reels or YouTube Shorts is open.
Grant Accessibility Service access to detect when Instagram Reels or YouTube Shorts are open and count vertical swipes.
Allow display over other apps so the Dynamic Island capsule appears automatically when watching Reels or Shorts.
